study: Existing SWAD training control source-user pilot; no novelty claim
validation: next user cyclically within users3..8; other four train; held user diagnostic only after all selection
input: audited legacy SignalNet with fixed prepared legacy channels; no moment branch or augmentation
scheduler: cosine over24 epochs; no early stopping of trajectory
checkpoint_interval: one epoch; segment average of every optimizer step, equal weight per epoch in SWAD
stop_on_failed_gate: no full eight-fold SWAD grid or seed expansion; keep negative pilot
limitations: source-only relative to outer fold1; six diagnostic users already have research history. Passing is a development screen, not untouched generalization or new algorithm. Official image data/protocol/learning-rate schedule are not reproduced.
